messages:
rachel: quick note  a customer hit a huge latency blip after doing a config sweep from the console. looks like the apply fanout spiked two router pools. logs: 

rachel: ```
[2026-03-23T07:45:01Z] apply: id=APPLY-999 user=omar scope=org:314 flags=120
[2026-03-23T07:45:02Z] orchestrator: enqueued_shards=18 total_tasks=720
[2026-03-23T07:45:03Z] router-us: queue_depth=590 capacity=600 workers=59
[2026-03-23T07:45:04Z] quota-svc: throttle=true auto_pause=triggered
```

omar: we did run preview but sampling missed a hot tenant. console had an org-default parallelism of 24 which is the culprit.

lena: proposal: add a lightweight preflight estimator endpoint (/v1/apply/estimate) that returns {estimated_peak, risk_level, suggested_parallelism, entropy_hint}. console should call it before the final apply and show a "suggest safe defaults" button.

ops-bot: incident created: router-pool spike (INC-2026-03-23-007).

omar: runtime changes: apply-coordinator should honor apply_controls.max_parallelism and use token-bucket per-pool. default console apply should be conservative (8). allow admin override but log audit.

rachel: ops: auto-pause at 80% pool utilization, show paused state with recommended actions. add telemetry: apply.preflight.risk, apply.fanout.inflight_by_pool.

lena: timeline: I'll add UX copy + button in 5 days; omar will prototype estimator in 4 days; rachel will update runbook in 3 days.

rachel: created ticket CFG-920. leaving thread open for updates. :eyes:
